item.title: Missiles Intercepted Near Riyadh After Yemen Fuel Depot Strike
item.description: A fuel storage facility close to Sanaa was targeted by the Saudi-led military coalition operating in Yemen. Following the strike, incoming missiles were intercepted near Riyadh.

item.title: ঢাকেশ্বরী মন্দিরে দুর্গাপূজার দেড় কোটি টাকার বাজেট

item.description: ইসরায়েলি প্রার্থীদের মধ্যে কেউ ফিলিস্তিন রাষ্ট্র গঠনের পক্ষে সমর্থন জানান কি না, তা নিয়ে প্রশ্ন উঠেছে। বিষয়টি বর্তমান রাজনৈতিক পরিস্থিতির সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত।

item.title: Ukraine reports frontline difficulties due to Starlink limitations
item.description: Kyiv indicates that restrictions on Elon Musk's Starlink network are impacting military operations. The satellite system has previously helped Ukrainian forces direct drones and defend airspace.

item.title: Dhaka to Cox's Bazar Mahanagar Express schedule finalized
item.description: The Mahanagar Express will depart Dhaka for Cox's Bazar every night at 8:30 PM. It is scheduled to reach Chattogram at 2:40 AM and arrive in Cox's Bazar by 6:00 AM.

item.title: Pacer Hasan reaches career-best ICC ranking after hat-trick
item.description: Bangladesh bowler Hasan Mahmud achieved a career-best position in the ICC rankings following a historic hat-trick against Afghanistan in Abu Dhabi. This milestone makes him the country's first fast bowler to take a Test hat-trick.

item.title: Riyadh-bound Houthi missile intercepted by coalition forces
item.description: Saudi Arabia's civil defence agency reported that the threat was neutralized after sending out emergency alerts through the national warning system.

item.title: Home-based civil servant allegedly held five jobs using makeup for sick leave
item.description: Kashim Chowdhury faces allegations of deceitfully managing multiple public sector positions remotely. He allegedly used makeup to simulate illness while working from home.

item.title: Rizvi claims harassment of Professor Yunus in New York harms nation's image
item.description: BNP leader Ruhul Kabir Rizvi stated that the recent harassment of former interim government leader Professor Muhammad Yunus in the US has damaged Bangladesh's reputation.

item.title: Actor Niti Taylor reveals director demanded sexual favors for movie role
item.description: Actor Niti Taylor shared in an interview that a Telugu film director once asked her for sexual relations in exchange for a movie role. She stated she was shocked, hung up immediately, and blocked the director's number.

item.title: EU sees no sign of halted intelligence sharing as power outages hit Ukraine
item.description: The European Commission stated there is no evidence that intelligence sharing with Ukraine has ceased, while Russian strikes left 600,000 people without electricity. Meanwhile, Ukrainian troops continue facing limits on Starlink satellite internet connectivity.

item.title: Swansea player Eom targeted by alleged racism at Millwall
item.description: Swansea City manager Vitor Matos stated that a prolonged pause in their 1-0 away victory over Millwall stemmed from racial insults directed at winger Ji-sung Eom.

item.description: As reported by ESPNcricinfo, The SA coach could look for middle-order replacements outside the current squad but he cautioned against overreacting to their 214. Key points: Conrad, Australia, middle, order.

item.title: AISA Denounces Arrests of Activists Following Jantar Mantar Protest
item.description: Delhi Police have registered an FIR against activists Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka for alleged trespassing near Jantar Mantar. AISA strongly condemned the detentions and the removal of the protest zone's notification status.

item.title: Vatican Reports Pope Leo Undergoes Lung Cancer Surgery
item.description: Pope Leo received a lung cancer diagnosis and underwent an operation to excise the lower portion of his right lung. The Vatican confirmed that the surgical procedure was successful.

item.description: As reported by The Hindu, The court noted that the NHRC order concerns the death of Rashid Raza. Key points: Delhi High Court, Rashid Raza, Narela Industrial Area, December.

item.title: Wayanad Traditional Rice Seed Protector Cheruvayal Raman Dies
item.description: Cheruvayal Raman, a well-known Wayanad conservationist of indigenous paddy seeds, has died. During his life, he showcased Kerala farming at global events such as the 2011 Hyderabad biodiversity conference and a Brazil agricultural seminar.

item.title: England Cricket Board Reconsiders Test Strategy for Bangladesh
item.description: Marcus Trescothick, chief selector for the England and Wales Cricket Board, stated that officials are reviewing team composition and spin bowling choices. These adjustments form part of ongoing planning for matches involving Bangladesh.

item.title: CMF Introduces Milk Carton Shaped Bluetooth Speakers
item.description: CMF, a subsidiary of Nothing, has revealed portable Bluetooth speakers designed like milk cartons that support pairing and Auracast technology. These new audio devices are the brand's first portable speaker offerings.

item.title: Bank of America Profit Falls After U.S. Treasury Fine
item.description: Bank of America reported a lower third-quarter profit following a financial penalty issued by the U.S. Treasury Department. Company shares experienced a drop in value after the penalty announcement.

item.title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue exceeds expectations by $909 million
item.description: As reported by CNBC, Morgan Stanley is expected to benefit from robust investment banking and equities trading revenue. Key points: Morgan Stanley, morgan, stanley, equities.

item.title: Samaira Garg’s initiative Made@gain provides notebooks to the needy
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, A school girl’s initiative, Made@gain has had a postive socio. Key points: Samaira Garg, Made, initiative, samaira.

item.title: US ends auto-extension of work permits; international students not impacted
item.description: As reported by Times of India, US ends auto-extension of work permits. Key points: extension, permits, international, students.

item.title: ‘We The Leaders’ will contest local body polls in Tamil Nadu: Annamalai
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, ‘We The Leaders’ is set to contest local body polls in Tamil Nadu. Key points: We The Leaders, Tamil Nadu, Annamalai, leaders.

item.title: Cornell University Halts All Fraternity Events Following Assault Claims
item.description: The institution prohibited fraternity gatherings due to public backlash over the handling of gang sexual assault accusations involving a student identified as Jane Doe.

item.title: Tamil Nadu announces 2027 board exam dates
item.description: Tamil Nadu has scheduled the Class 12 board examinations to commence on March 3, 2027, followed by Class 10 exams starting March 17. Additionally, Class 11 arrear tests will run from March 5 to April 1, 2027.

item.title: ইসলামে নেতৃত্বের মূলনীতি ও প্রিয়নবীর আদর্শ
item.description: ইসলামে নেতৃত্বকে একটি পবিত্র সামাজিক দায়িত্ব হিসেবে গণ্য করা হয়। মহানবী হযরত মুহাম্মদ (সা.) আধ্যাত্মিক ও রাজনৈতিক ক্ষেত্রে আদর্শ নেতৃত্বের অনন্য নজির স্থাপন করেছেন।

item.title: Rahul Gandhi holds press briefing amid political tension
item.description: Rahul Gandhi addressed a media briefing in Delhi following opposition backlash over police intervention against protesters. Demonstrators had gathered to demand the dismissal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

item.title: ঢাকায় সরকারি হাসপাতালে সন্তান জন্মদানে খরচ মাত্র ৭৫ টাকা
item.description: রাজধানীর একটি সরকারি হাসপাতালে মাত্র ৭৫ টাকায় দুই সন্তানের জন্ম হয়েছে বলে জানা গেছে। অথচ বর্তমানে শহরে সন্তান প্রসবের জন্য অনেকের উচ্চ ব্যয় হয় এবং অস্ত্রোপচারের হারও অনেক বেশি।

item.title: Iran increases surveillance amid Strait of Hormuz attacks
item.description: Vessels navigating the Strait of Hormuz face a severe wave of assaults, marking the most intense period of attacks since the conflict began. Concurrently, Iran has intensified its monitoring operations in the area.

item.title: Recent updates in international cricket rankings
item.description: Iyer has advanced to the fourth position in the T20I batting standings. Meanwhile, Markram entered the top ten for Test batters, and Hazlewood climbed to seventh among Test bowlers.

item.title: Meerut court hands death penalty in 'blue drum' murder
item.description: A Meerut district court on September 30, 2026, condemned Muskan Rastogi and Sahil Shukla to death. The pair was convicted for the murder of merchant navy officer Saurabh Rajput.

item.title: Activists criticize incomplete accessibility tender for Marina Beach
item.description: Campaigners claim the procurement notice for a disability-friendly pathway at Marina beach lacks crucial technical details and a long-term maintenance agreement. They are urging authorities to include comprehensive lifecycle planning and dedicated staff.

item.title: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষকদের প্রশিক্ষণ সময় বাড়ানোর পরিকল্পনা
item.description: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষার মান বাড়ানোর লক্ষ্যে শিক্ষক প্রশিক্ষণের মেয়াদ আড়াই বছর থেকে বাড়িয়ে তিন বছর করার চিন্তা করছে সরকার। প্রতিমন্ত্রী এই তথ্য জানিয়েছেন।

item.title: Erode Turmeric Rates Surpass ₹23,000 per Quintal
item.description: Turmeric rates in Erode have exceeded ₹23,000 a quintal. Drought across key producing areas like Marathwada, Nizamabad, and Tamil Nadu is driving the increase.

item.title: Assam Board Orders Adult Trial for 17-Year-Old in Rape Case
item.description: The Juvenile Justice Board in Hailakandi permitted a 17-year-old accused of rape to face trial as an adult. Police stated the principal magistrate issued the ruling due to the severity of the offense.

item.title: Lawyer Says 'Blue Drum' Murder Defendants Stunned by Death Sentence
item.description: Muskan and Sahil were reportedly shocked upon receiving the death penalty for murdering former Merchant Navy officer Saurabh Rajput. Authorities discovered the victim's remains inside a blue plastic drum at his residence.

item.title: Karnataka Dismisses CBI Inquiry Into Alleged Sting Operation
item.description: Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge rejected a CBI probe, stating state law enforcement will manage the investigation. He noted that the central agency still has pending inquiries from the state.

item.title: Buyer Awarded ₹1.1 Lakh Over Defective Tata Curvv EV Charging Port
item.description: A Hyderabad consumer forum ruled that a Tata Curvv EV was sold with a broken charging port and ordered ₹1.1 lakh in compensation plus free repairs. The purchaser faced recurring problems following failed dealer fix attempts.

item.title: Tyreek Hill Faces Potential NFL Suspension Amid Uncertain Future
item.description: Former Miami Dolphins player Tyreek Hill faces the possibility of an NFL suspension. His prospects for returning to the Chiefs have encountered setbacks.

item.title: Italian PM Meloni Criticizes US-Russia Diesel Agreement as Dangerous
item.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the recent US-Russia diesel accord as a highly hazardous decision. Under the pact, Moscow will initially provide over 300,000 metric tonnes of diesel to American and international markets.

item.title: Delhi Metro Clarifies No Services Were Halted During Demonstrations
item.description: The Delhi Metro informed the Supreme Court that zero trains were canceled during protests. According to court filings, the network operated all 4,157 scheduled trips on October 10 using 271 trains.

item.title: China's Massive Gaming Sector Drives Global Regulation
item.description: With over 700 million players, China represents the globe's biggest gaming sector while maintaining strict government oversight. These heavy domestic controls create repercussions that affect gamers worldwide.

item.title: নিরাপত্তার স্বার্থে প্রাসাদ পরিবর্তন করছেন সৌদি যুবরাজ
item.description: হুতি বিদ্রোহীদের ক্রমাগত হামলার মুখে নিরাপত্তার কারণে সৌদি যুবরাজ মোহাম্মদ বিন সালমানকে এক রাজপ্রাসাদ থেকে অন্যটিতে স্থানান্তর করা হয়েছে। অন্যদিকে, সৌদি নেতৃত্বাধীন জোটের ওপর হামলার পর আরও প্রতিশোধ নেওয়ার হুমকি দিয়েছে হুতিরা।

item.title: BJD Objects to Incoming Odisha Governor's Remarks
item.description: The BJD expressed deep dismay over comments by newly appointed Odisha Governor Braj Mohan Ram. He reportedly stated an intention to help build up the BJP party apparatus.

item.title: Lawyers Object to Rahul Gandhi's Supreme Court March
item.description: Roughly 200 legal professionals contacted the Supreme Court Bar Association to protest a political march led by Rahul Gandhi. They stated the demonstration improperly turned the judiciary into a stage for political signaling.

item.title: NASA Identifies Australian Feature as Impact Crater
item.description: Satellite imagery captured by NASA indicates that a geological formation in Australia known as the giant spider is an old impact crater.

item.title: TMC to Maintain Autonomy Until Local Polls: G.K. Vasan
item.description: Tamil Maanila Congress leader G.K. Vasan announced the party will operate independently through the upcoming local body elections. However, the organization will collaborate with Congress at the national level.
